subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@1.1.2` replace `^0.0.44` for the next acpx release after the Codex compatibility and macOS trust checks pass?
rationale: The bug and preferred pinned-launch direction are established, but the major adapter upgrade and security-sensitive macOS artifact require an explicit release-target decision.

options.title: Ship validated 1.1.2
options.body: Adopt the reporter-proven current release after full ACP behavior and affected-macOS trust validation.

options.title: Wait for another release
options.body: Keep the issue open until a newer adapter release is available and passes equivalent compatibility and trust checks.

recommendation.title: Ship validated 1.1.2
recommendation.body: Adopt the reporter-proven current release after full ACP behavior and affected-macOS trust validation.
